title: 第378章 魔宗老祖再现第377章 赵家与邪修
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：地狱首领穿越58有空间第一卷：默认第378章魔宗老祖再现（..la）三天很快过去了，这天夜色比以往更加浓稠，乌云压顶，星月全无，整座青石镇被一片死寂笼罩。
晚风，带着一股淡淡的腐臭阴寒之气，寻常百姓足不出户。
家家户户灯火尽数熄灭，仿佛连天地都在预示今夜必有血光之灾。
夜半子时，赵家府邸深处的密室，骤然亮起一抹诡异的血红微光。
石壁上原本隐晦暗淡的血色符文尽数苏醒，猩红光芒蜿蜒交错，如同无数嗜血毒虫攀爬游走。
整座阴煞聚灵阵全速运转，无数漆黑煞气从地底、从宅院四方汇聚而来。
盘旋在密室上空，凝成一团翻滚的黑雾，阴气刺骨，冻结空气。
“咔咔…”
厚重的密室石门无人自开，向内缓缓滑开。
六道黑袍人影，踏着无边阴雾，缓步走入赵家密室。
六人通体笼罩在宽大黑袍之下，面容隐在阴影之中，只露出一双双灰白死寂的瞳孔。
周身缠绕浓稠不散的煞气，每一步落下，地面青石都会凝结出一层薄薄的黑霜。
正是三日之前暗中布阵、与赵家暗中勾结的六名邪修。
为首一人身材高瘦，黑袍领口渗出缕缕暗红血丝，气息最为阴戾深沉。
乃是六人的领头邪修，修为远超其余五人，已然踏入筑基后期境界。
他缓缓抬头，灰白瞳孔盯着祭坛上的黑木盒，沙哑阴冷的声音在密室回荡。
“三日聚煞，地气尽吸，此阵已成，足以炼化那少年修士的肉身灵力。”
旁边一名矮瘦邪修阴笑一声，声音尖锐刺耳：“赵家家主倒是识趣，倾尽全族生机供我等养阵。
那张昊宇不过一介散修，天赋再高，今夜也插翅难飞！”
“听闻他年纪轻轻修为不俗，正好擒回去，抽魂炼魄，炼制一具极品阴煞傀儡。”

六人低声狞笑，戾气滔天。
院外暗处，两道挺拔身影静静伫立。
张昊宇负手而立，龙佳颖站在旁边，隐身于阴影之中，眸光淡漠冰冷，将密室之内一切尽收眼底。
这三日里，他看似静坐休养，实则早已布下天罗地网。
他以自身精纯浩然灵力，在赵家府邸四周悄无声息布下灵禁。
此阵法无形无迹，不破坏阴煞阵分毫，不会惊动邪修，却能彻底封锁整片区域的空间流转、灵力遁逃。
今夜此地，方圆一公里，已成绝地。
这些邪修，来了，便再也走不掉。
密室之内，为首黑袍领头抬手一挥，滔天黑煞骤然翻滚涌动。
“时辰已到，动身，斩除后患！”
六名邪修齐齐动身，黑袍翻飞，六道阴邪气息直冲夜空，欲踏出密室，直奔张昊宇居所袭杀而去。
可就在六人踏出密室门槛的刹那，
“嗡！”
一声沉闷厚重的轰鸣骤然炸响！
整片天地骤然一暗，无形结界瞬间封顶！
原本流转自如的阴煞邪气瞬间凝固，空气如同变成坚硬钢铁，死死禁锢住六人的身形。
六人脚步一顿，脸色骤变，灰白瞳孔中第一次浮现出惊恐之色。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Hell Leader Crossing 58 There is Space Volume 1: Default Chapter 378 The Demon Sect Ancestor Reappears (..la) Three days passed quickly. The night was thicker than before, with dark clouds, no stars and moon, and the entire Bluestone Town was shrouded in deathly silence.
The evening breeze carried a faint rancid and cold air, and ordinary people stayed at home.
All the lights in every house were extinguished, as if even heaven and earth were foretelling that there would be a bloody disaster tonight.
In the middle of the night, a strange blood-red light suddenly lit up in the secret room deep in the Zhao family's mansion.
All the originally obscure and dim blood-colored runes on the stone wall came to life, and the scarlet light meandered and crisscrossed, like countless bloodthirsty poisonous insects climbing and swimming.
The entire Yin Evil Spirit Gathering Array was operating at full speed, and countless dark evil spirits gathered from the ground and from all directions of the house.
Hovering over the secret room, it condensed into a billowing black mist. The yin energy was biting and frozen in the air.
"Kaka..."
No one opened the thick stone door of the secret room, and it slowly slid inwards.
Six figures in black robes walked slowly into the Zhao family's secret room through the boundless mist.
The six people were all shrouded in large black robes, and their faces were hidden in the shadows, with only pairs of gray and dead pupils exposed.
Thick and lingering evil energy is wrapped around his body, and with every step he takes, a thin layer of black frost will condense on the bluestone on the ground.
It was the six evil cultivators who secretly formed the formation three days ago and secretly colluded with the Zhao family.
The leader was tall and thin, with streaks of dark red blood seeping from the collar of his black robe, and his aura was the most sinister and deep.
He is the leader of the six evil cultivators. His cultivation level far exceeds that of the other five, and he has already entered the late stage of foundation building.
He slowly raised his head, his gray-white pupils staring at the black wooden box on the altar, and his hoarse and cold voice echoed in the secret room.
"After three days of gathering evil spirits and absorbing all the earth's energy, the formation is complete and is enough to refine the physical and spiritual power of the young monk."
A short, thin evil cultivator next to him laughed sinisterly, his voice sharp and harsh: "The head of the Zhao family is wise and devoted all his family's vitality to support us in raising the formation.
That Zhang Haoyu is just a casual cultivator. No matter how talented he is, he can't fly tonight! "
"I heard that he has good cultivation at a young age, so I just happened to capture him, extract his soul and refine his soul, and make a top-quality Yin evil puppet."
The six people laughed in low voices and their anger was overwhelming.
In the darkness outside the courtyard, two tall figures stood quietly.
Zhang Haoyu stood with his hands behind his back, and Long Jiaying stood beside him, hiding in the shadows, his eyes indifferent and cold, taking in everything in the secret room.
In the past three days, he seemed to be sitting quietly and recuperating, but in fact he had already laid a dragnet.
He used his pure and mighty spiritual power to quietly set up a spiritual ban around the Zhao family's residence.
This formation is invisible and traceless, does not destroy the Yin Evil Formation at all, and will not alarm evil cultivators, but it can completely block the spatial flow and escape of spiritual energy in the entire area.
Tonight, this place, with a radius of one kilometer, has become a desert.
Once these evil cultivators come, they can never leave.
In the secret room, the leader in black robe raised his hand and waved, and the black evil suddenly rolled and surged in the sky.
"The time has come, let's set out and eliminate future troubles!"
The six evil cultivators set out together, their black robes flying, and six evil auras shooting straight into the night sky. They wanted to step out of the secret room and went straight to Zhang Haoyu's residence to attack and kill him.
But the moment the six people stepped out of the secret room,
"Buzz!"
A dull and heavy roar suddenly exploded!
The whole world suddenly went dark, and the invisible barrier was instantly capped!
The evil energy that had been flowing freely solidified instantly, and the air seemed to turn into hard steel, tightly confining the six people's bodies.
The six people paused, their faces suddenly changed, and for the first time, a look of fear appeared in their gray-white pupils.
